title: This is GARBAGE! Not worth $15 let alone $150!
text:
This is GARBAGE! Not worth $15 let alone $150!. Update: I’m updating my review to 3 stars because they sent me a replacement seat for free and I didn’t have to pay for shipping.

I got this chair because it looked like a decent chair at a fair price.

When it arrived today I was very excited to get it assembled and replace my old worn down chair.

Everything was going well until it came to attaching the arm rests to the base of the chair. The screws didn’t fit the hole for the right arm rest!! I tried screwing in the screw into the hole and it wouldn’t fit! I double checked and triple checked the instructions to make sure it was the correct screw and it definitely was. The left armrest screwed in no problem but the right one just will not screw in.

This tells me that even their machinery is crap (let alone the quality of the product itself) if even the screw holes are poor quality.

Unless the manufacturer sends a new chair base at no cost to me I will absolutely be returning this chair for a refund and buying something else even if it costs more.

I will update this review if anything changes but as of now I highly recommend staying away from this chair.

Hopefully this will help others from making the mistake I did of buying this.

I’m really bummed now.
